blogs.title: Unlocking AI's Memory: How We're Teaching Models to Read Millions of Words at Once
blogs.description: An overview for non-technical readers explaining the current bottleneck in Large Language Models (LLMs) regarding 'context windows.' This post demystifies why modern chats often hit short memory caps and introduces the concept of context extension as the solution, highlighting how we can now enable AI to understand entire books or legal contracts in a single prompt without changing the underlying intelligence.

blogs.title: The Math Behind Grokking Longer Texts: A Look at Non-Uniform Positional Interpolation
blogs.description: A accessible deep dive into the technical problem of 'catastrophic values' when linearly stretching model positions. This post explains how standard methods lose positional information, and introduces the paper's core innovation: discovering specific patterns (non-uniformities) in how data is embedded that allow models to stretch past their original training limits while keeping their original performance intact.

blogs.title: The Evolutionary Secret Battle: No Fine-Tuning Required for Massive Context
blogs.description: We break down how researchers used an evolutionary search algorithm to act as 'digital critics' testing thousands of mathematical solutions to find perfect token rotation angles. This post explains the clever 'progressive extension' strategy—where you train on a moderate length (256k), pause, do a quick trick (LongRoPE), and instantly jump to 2 million tokens—saving massive amounts of compute time and money.
